method: UA-DETRAC XML files contain no location field (only camera_state, sence_weather and ignored_region). Sites were inferred by inspecting median-background thumbnails of all 100 videos (site_grouping_all_sheet.png, site_grouping/zoom_eval.png) together with an automatic gradient-correlation clustering (site_grouping.py, site_groups.json). Where two videos plausibly show the same road from the same or a nearby camera, they were MERGED (conservative: over-merging only reduces the number of folds, under-merging would leak scene information across folds).
uncertain_merges: A: 20051/20052 and 20032-35 are wider/shifted views of the same boulevard as 20011/20061-65 (bus shelter, railing). B: 40141 resembles 39761/39771 (hedged divider) but is not certainly the same camera. C: 63544 shows a different framing but was recorded in the same rainy session (6352x-6354x) as 63521/63525 and resembles 40131. All were merged.
